events.text: The Kessel Road pumping station operates two duty pumps.
The Kessel Road pumping station now operates three duty pumps after the 2022 expansion.
Kessel Road pumping station operates four duty pumps since the 2025 refit.
The free chlorine target at the reservoir outlet is 0.5 milligrams per litre.
The free chlorine target at the reservoir outlet was raised to 0.8 milligrams per litre.
The free chlorine target at the reservoir outlet is 0.7 milligrams per litre; the 0.8 figure was a data-entry mistake.
Telemetry and SCADA run on Wonderware InTouch.
Telemetry and SCADA moved to Ignition 7.
Telemetry and SCADA were upgraded to Ignition 8.0.
Telemetry and SCADA were upgraded to Ignition 8.1.
Telemetry and SCADA now run Ignition 8.3.
Customers receive water bills every quarter.
Customers now receive water bills every two months.
Billing moved to a two-month cycle because customers complained that quarterly bills were too large to budget for.
The billing system migration to SAP finished in March 2024.
Smart meter readings are collected over the Arqiva network.
Smart meter readings are now collected over the Itron mesh network.
The Kessel Road pumping station upgrade budget is 2 million pounds.
The Kessel Road pumping station upgrade budget is now 4 million pounds.
The Kessel Road pumping station operates six duty pumps.
The Kessel Road depot canteen opens at 7 in the morning.
Leak detection on trunk mains uses acoustic loggers.
